review_candidates.title: Network Technical Support Engineer – Remote & Field Support
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The successful candidate will act as a technical escalation point, helping on-site engineers install, configure, troubleshoot and maintain network infrastructure including switches, routers and related equipment. This is a hands-on networking role focused on remote configuration and troubleshooting, rather than general desktop/IT support. Key Responsibilities Provide remote technical support to engineers working at customer sites. Configure and troubleshoot switches, routers and network devices
eligibility_evidence: About the Role Global Smart Hands is looking for an experienced Network Technical Support Engineer to provide remote technical support to our field/on-site engineers working at customer locations.

The successful candidate will act as a technical escalation point, helping on-site engineers install, configure, troubleshoot and maintain network infrastructure including switches, routers and related equipment.
What We Are Looking For We are looking for someone who can take a request such as: "The engineer is on-site.
Connect to the device remotely or through the on-site engineer.
